description: The National Library of Trinidad and Tobago, opened in 2003, is the administrative seat and focal point of NALIS libraries and information service centres in Trinidad and Tobago. The National Library houses the Heritage Library collection, a Children's Library, a Young Adult Library and an Adult Library with reference services. Listed opening hours: Monday - Friday 8:30AM - 6:00PM. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
